scope: Native installer document payload integrity only, not DSP, binary/source equivalence, signing, DAW acceptance or release authorization
acceptance: Independently compare extracted/installed notices to the exact clean checkout and configured JUCE licence, not only self-reported manifest hashes
Check full expected commit, tree, repository URL, complete unique manifest inventory, document size/hash and truthful limited-scope SOURCE.txt
Reject missing, changed, rehashed counterfeit, linked, unexpected, duplicate and traversal-path payloads
Linux: build the actual .deb and inspect its extracted documents without system installation
macOS: build the actual .pkg and expand its document component without system installation; architecture naming must reflect inspected binary slices, not a hardcoded universal label
Windows: compile actual Inno Setup definition and inspect documents from a silent Standalone-only install into the ephemeral runner temp directory; no VST3 installation or DAW claim
Preserve native source SHA, package SHA-256, document verification receipt and installer logs as CI evidence; do not publish a release
